name: Alzheimer Disease and Related Dementias Qualifying Admissions
description: Beneficiary-admission file containing MedPAR inpatient admissions that meet the adrd__icdcodeset01__dx1__all_admissions outcome definition. Rows identify included beneficiaries/admissions with the condition for the configured diagnosis-position and admissions-criteria rule.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted beneficiary identifier from the linked MedPAR admission record
content.adm_id: String: Unique admission identifier for the qualifying inpatient stay
content.outcome: String: Outcome short name, such as cvd, adrd, or stroke
content.codeset: String: Outcome code set identifier used to define qualifying diagnosis codes
content.diagnosis_position: String: Diagnosis-position rule used to evaluate MedPAR diagnosis codes, such as dx1 or dx1_10
content.admissions_criteria: String: Admission-selection rule, such as all_admissions or readmit30d
content.primary_diagnosis: String: Principal diagnosis code for the inpatient stay
content.diagnoses: List[String]: Diagnosis codes evaluated against the outcome definition
content.included_bene: Int32: Indicator that the beneficiary/admission met the outcome definition and cohort rule
